questions.prompt: lib.git has version 1.1. Why did work/lib get 1.0?
options: The project records a commit id; update checks out exactly that commit
The clone was made before 1.1 existed
Submodules always use the oldest tag

questions.prompt: Inside work/lib after the update, what is HEAD?
options: On a branch named after the project
Unset; the submodule has no HEAD

goals.label: work/lib is checked out at the commit the project pins

check.script: test "$(git -C lib rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD:lib)"

goals.label: A second clone named fresh has its submodule filled
